verses.text: Sing for joy in the LORD, O you righteous ones; Praise is becoming to the upright.
verses.textZh: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂；正直人的讚美是合宜的。

verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; Sing praises to Him with a harp of ten strings.
verses.textZh: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華，用十弦瑟歌頌他。

verses.text: Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.
verses.textZh: 應當向他唱新歌，彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。

verses.text: For the word of the LORD is upright, And all His work is [done] in faithfulness.
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華的言語正直；凡他所做的盡都誠實。

verses.text: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 他喜愛仁義公平；遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。

verses.text: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, And by the breath of His mouth all their host.
verses.textZh: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造；萬象藉他口中的氣而成。

verses.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.textZh: 他聚集海水如壘，收藏深洋在庫房。

verses.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
verses.textZh: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！願世上的居民都懼怕他！

verses.text: For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.textZh: 因為他說有，就有，命立，就立。

verses.text: The LORD nullifies the counsel of the nations; He frustrates the plans of the peoples.
verses.textZh: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有，使眾民的思念無有功效。

verses.text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, The plans of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定；他心中的思念萬代常存。

verses.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, The people whom He has chosen for His own inheritance.
verses.textZh: 以耶和華為神的，那國是有福的！他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！

verses.text: The LORD looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of men;
verses.textZh: 耶和華從天上觀看；他看見一切的世人。

verses.text: From His dwelling place He looks out On all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.textZh: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民。

verses.text: He who fashions the hearts of them all, He who understands all their works.
verses.textZh: 他是那造成他們眾人心的，留意他們一切作為的。

verses.text: The king is not saved by a mighty army; A warrior is not delivered by great strength.
verses.textZh: 君王不能因兵多得勝；勇士不能因力大得救。

verses.text: A horse is a false hope for victory; Nor does it deliver anyone by its great strength.
verses.textZh: 靠馬得救是枉然的；馬也不能因力大救人。

verses.text: Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear Him, On those who hope for His lovingkindness,
verses.textZh: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人和仰望他慈愛的人，

verses.text: To deliver their soul from death And to keep them alive in famine.
verses.textZh: 要救他們的命脫離死亡，並使他們在饑荒中存活。

verses.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
verses.textZh: 我們的心向來等候耶和華；他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。

verses.text: For our heart rejoices in Him, Because we trust in His holy name.
verses.textZh: 我們的心必靠他歡喜，因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。

verses.text: Let Your lovingkindness, O LORD, be upon us, According as we have hoped in You.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你照著我們所仰望你的，向我們施行慈愛！
